items.text: AI workflow startup Relay is shutting down, with its staff joining Google’s Chrome team.
items.text_zh: AI 工作流初创公司 Relay 宣布关闭，其员工将加入谷歌 Chrome 团队。

items.text: Former SpaceX engineers are building an automated factory designed to manufacture steel components with robotics.
items.text_zh: 多名前 SpaceX 工程师正在建设一座利用机器人制造钢制零部件的自动化工厂。

items.text: Arena added task categories and cost-to-completion data to its Agent Leaderboard, enabling performance-and-price comparisons.
items.text_zh: Arena 为智能体排行榜新增任务类别和任务完成成本数据，方便用户同时比较性能与价格。

items.text: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 reached first place for video editing on Arena’s crowdsourced Video Arena leaderboard.
items.text_zh: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 登上 Arena 众测视频排行榜的视频编辑项目第一名。

items.text: Replit introduced black-box penetration tests that probe deployed apps externally, with Replit Agent able to address detected vulnerabilities.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出从外部探测已部署应用的黑盒渗透测试，并可由 Replit Agent 修复发现的漏洞。

items.text: Nvidia’s Nemotron 3.5 Lightning became available through Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for streamlined model deployment.
items.text_zh: 英伟达 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 已登陆 Amazon SageMaker JumpStart，以简化模型部署流程。

items.text: Cartesia’s Sonic 3.6 took first place in both Provider Voice and Controlled Voice on Artificial Analysis’s Speech Arena.
items.text_zh: Cartesia Sonic 3.6 在 Artificial Analysis 语音竞技场的供应商音色和受控音色两项排名中均位居第一。

items.text: Cartesia’s Sonic 3.6 generated 136.1 characters per second and cost $49 per million characters in Artificial Analysis testing.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 测得 Cartesia Sonic 3.6 每秒生成 136.1 个字符，每百万字符成本为 49 美元。

items.text: AWS published a reference workflow enabling OpenClaw agents to conduct transactions through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore’s payment capabilities.
items.text_zh: AWS 发布参考工作流，让 OpenClaw 智能体能够通过 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 的支付能力完成交易。

items.text: Voice-input startup Wispr raised $280 million at a $2 billion valuation as it expands beyond dictation.
items.text_zh: 语音输入初创公司 Wispr 以 20 亿美元估值融资 2.8 亿美元，并计划拓展到听写之外的场景。

items.text: Palona raised $20 million to develop AI automation products for physical retail and other brick-and-mortar businesses.
items.text_zh: Palona 融资 2000 万美元，用于开发面向实体零售及其他线下企业的 AI 自动化产品。

items.text: ElevenLabs launched a Claude-compatible MCP integration for securely managing voice and conversational agents without running a separate server.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 推出兼容 Claude 的 MCP 集成，无需另行运行服务器即可安全管理语音和对话智能体。

items.text: OpenAI said retained reasoning and compaction raised GPT-5.6 Sol’s ARC-AGI-3 score from 13.3% to 38.3% while using roughly sixfold fewer output tokens.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 称，保留推理与上下文压缩让 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 ARC-AGI-3 成绩从 13.3% 升至 38.3%，输出令牌约减少六倍。

items.text: LlamaIndex said ExtractBench only credits extracted fields when both the value and its source citation are correct.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 表示，ExtractBench 只有在提取值及其来源引用均正确时，才会判定该字段得分。
